loops.name: The loop, as it stands on 17 Oct
steps: Prompt rule: local metres, no Geo nodes unless asked
loops.evidence:
1. A model writes X3D (system prompt: DSPy no-Full rule pack).
2. The exact validator (fork d5598c4 or newer) says what is wrong; the model repairs.
3. A real browser render (X_ITE 16.5.1) says whether anything is in view. A pixel or edge check against a known-good render, where one exists, is exact.
4. Vision judges, three at a time, both orders, with a tie option, say whether it looks like the target. Only agreed points count.
5. Blender owns the look (Cycles), X3D stays master for behaviour and provenance; every step carries an x3dprov record.
6. What the judges and renders catch that the validator does not becomes a new validator rule or prompt rule.
